summary: Runs Android Auto on the motorcycle's screen.
tagline: Android Auto on the motorcycle's screen: maps, music and calls.

summary: Turns a ride, a saved route or the NAV route into a 3D film.
tagline: Your rides, flown again: a 3D film of any ride, with a soundtrack written for it.

summary: Plans a ride you have not done yet and simulates it for a Flyby film.
tagline: Rides you haven't done yet: curated Experiences across Europe, simulated for a Flyby film.

summary: Connects a Wi-Fi dashcam: live view, recording, photos, settings and card files.
tagline: Your Wi-Fi dashcam in the app, and on the Dashboard's map panel.

summary: Records your rides to your own Dawarich server, or starts the Dawarich app with the ride.
tagline: Your rides on your own Dawarich server, recorded while you ride.

summary: Shows the photos of your own Immich server on the NAV map.
tagline: Your Immich photos on the NAV map, right where you took them.

summary: Live traffic, places, search and road info from your own free TomTom key.
tagline: TomTom traffic and places on the NAV map, on your phone only.
